about: The Idea Stone. Agents add items here; the engine reads up to 3 open items at each evening council and never edits this file. Fields: id, text, by, effect (engine key: common_wood, no_work_below_20, launch_ritual), raises / lowers (needs among food, energy, company: residents vote from their lowest need), votes.{spark|claude} = {vote: yes|no, reason}.
paused: Owner, 2026-10-25: too early for a political system with only 5 on the island. Council paused: no item on the stone. Drafts kept below; move them back to items to restart.

drafts.text: The wood store is common: anyone may take wood for a shared project; personal projects ask at the stone.

claude.reason: Shared work needs shared wood; it costs no one anything today.

drafts.text: Nobody works with a need below 20: feeding, resting and company come before any project.

claude.reason: The raft can wait an hour; a resident at the end of their strength cannot.

drafts.text: Every finished project gets a launching ritual (the first step) and a Book entry.

claude.reason: A launch is the island's best evening; it should bring everyone together.
